SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT L.LOST_ID AS ID, 'lost' AS ITEM_TYPE, L.TITLE, L.ITEM_NAME, L.STATUS, CASE WHEN L.STATUS IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED') THEN '반환완료' WHEN L.STATUS IN ('STORED', 'STORAGE') THEN '보관중' ELSE '접수중' END AS STATUS_NAME, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, L.LOST_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, L.LOST_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, L.VIEW_COUNT, LOC.LATITUDE, LOC.LONGITUDE, '/lost/detail/' || L.LOST_ID AS DETAIL_URL, IMG.IMAGE_URL, L.CREATED_AT FROM LOST_ITEMS L LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORDER, 9999), IMAGE_ID) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'lost' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_ID = L.LOST_ID
AND L.STATUS NOT IN ('DELETED', 'HIDDEN')
AND 1 = 1
AND L.STATUS IN ('REGISTERED', 'RECEIVED')
AND L.STATUS IN ('STORED', 'STORAGE')
AND L.STATUS IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED')
AND 1 = 0
AND ( LOWER(L.TITLE) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(L.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(LOC.LOCATION_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
UNION ALL
SELECT F.FOUND_ID AS ID, 'found' AS ITEM_TYPE, F.TITLE, F.ITEM_NAME, F.STATUS, CASE WHEN F.STATUS IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED') THEN '반환완료' WHEN F.STATUS IN ('REGISTERED', 'RECEIVED') THEN '접수중' ELSE '보관중' END AS STATUS_NAME, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, F.FOUND_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, F.FOUND_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, F.VIEW_COUNT, LOC.LATITUDE, LOC.LONGITUDE, '/found/detail/' || F.FOUND_ID AS DETAIL_URL, IMG.IMAGE_URL, F.CREATED_AT FROM FOUND_ITEMS F LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORDER, 9999), IMAGE_ID) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'found' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_ID = F.FOUND_ID
AND F.STATUS NOT IN ('DELETED', 'HIDDEN')
AND 1 = 1
AND F.STATUS IN ('REGISTERED', 'RECEIVED')
AND F.STATUS IN ('STORED', 'STORAGE')
AND F.STATUS IN ('RETURNED', 'COMPLETED')
AND 1 = 0
AND ( LOWER(F.TITLE) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(F.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(LOC.LOCATION_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100
